run_bench_hamming_knn: run the FAISS Hamming distance k-NN benchmark across multiple vector dimensions and k values
create_random_binary_vectors: create random uint8 binary vectors using faiss.randint for Hamming distance search
run_knn_hamming_search: run k-nearest neighbor search on binary vectors using faiss.knn_hamming with hc or mc variants
set_omp_threads: set the number of OpenMP threads for FAISS operations using faiss.omp_set_num_threads
benchmark_knn_hamming_variants: benchmark faiss.knn_hamming performance across different k values and hc/mc variants
